svg.text: The MB are italian_flat's (3.4 M triangles) with lit, the tensors of each implementation at its load. Its first picture: 72.0 s cold
(the file converted, the program built), 23.9 s warm with the lights baked; less since the hosts' tables are kept (12.3 s).
The far field: built on the host afterwards, joined at the next load

The weights (bfp8_b tiles) and the field's model become tensors of the load that finds the files; the open's frames never wait for them.
